requirements.text: start.sh launches the cluster in foreground and keeps serving while alive
Three HTTP nodes on 8000/8001/8002 answer GET /api/health with correct node_id
Auth register/login/me work per contract (slug validation, password length, token length, 409/400/401)
Workspaces/channels CRUD, roles, join semantics, archiving behave per contract
Durable channel events share dense per-channel seq, replay on reconnect to a different node, fan out across cluster via Redis with sqlite fallback
Killing one HTTP node or the Redis daemon does not stop reads/writes/WS/IRC on the others; fan-out recovers within 5s
IRC gateway supports login/nick/join/names/ping/privmsg/quit, numeric replies, and bidirectional bridging with web
Browser SPA supports signup/login/logout, channel CRUD, messages (post/edit/delete), threads, reactions, pins, empty states per Computer-Use checklist

preferences.rule: File ownership table: lead owns CONTRACTS.md/PROMPT.md/start.sh/bin/**/launcher; REST API agent owns huddle/api/** + tests/api/**; cluster/WS agent owns huddle/config.py, huddle/events.py, huddle/web/**, huddle/node.py, huddle/miniredis.py, tests/cluster/**; IRC agent owns huddle/irc/** + tests/irc/**; browser client agent owns huddle/static/** + tests/ui/**. Never edit a file you don't own.
Agents must not write start.sh or any supervisor/launcher — that is lead-owned.

huddle/events.py exposes ensure_schema/append/publish/publish_global/online_user_ids/head_seq exactly as specified; append must be called inside a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and publish called after commit.
huddle/web/http.py defines Request/Response and handle_api(req) entry point in huddle/api/app.py; node serves GET / and /static/* and SPA deep-link fallback.

Pinned SQLite schema for users/tokens/workspaces/workspace_members/channels/channel_members (API agent) and channel_events (cluster agent) must match the column contract so other components can read them.

WebSocket /api/ws?token=... semantics (subscribe auth rules, resume/resumed/resume.gap, ping/pong) are fixed by the contract; IRC gateway only talks to nodes via REST+WS, never touches the DB directly.
Each component agent owns and must pass its own test directory (tests/api, tests/cluster, tests/irc, tests/ui) before considering its piece done.
Tests must use isolated data dirs/ports per component (API 18000, cluster 28000/26379, IRC 38000/36379/36667, UI 48000/46379) so parallel agents don't collide.
Build components in parallel where independent (REST API, cluster/WS, IRC, browser client), since the contracts file is designed to let them proceed without waiting on each other.
